scripts.build: node -e "const env=(process.env.VITE_APP_ENV||'').toLowerCase().replace(/['\"]/g,'').trim();const cmd=env.includes('staging')?'npm run build:staging':'npm run build:production';const {execSync}=require('child_process');console.log('[build] clean_env='+env+' -> '+cmd);execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});"
scripts.build:production: cross-env VITE_APP_ENV=production vite build --mode production && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.mjs && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/index.js
scripts.build:staging: cross-env VITE_APP_ENV=staging vite build --mode staging && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.mjs && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/index.js
scripts.vercel-build: node -e "const env=(process.env.VITE_APP_ENV||'').toLowerCase().replace(/['\"]/g,'').trim();const cmd=env.includes('staging')?'npm run build:staging':'npm run build:production';const {execSync}=require('child_process');console.log('[vercel-build] clean_env='+env+' -> '+cmd);execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});"
